property_summary: After any call to c (including the fallback), the contract's balance is always a multiple of 10 ether, because the fallback only accepts exactly 10 ether and sometimes transfers the entire balance back.
After any successful fallback call, the balance of the contract is always less than 10 ether when block.number is not divisible by 15.
After calling the fallback with 10 ether, the contract's balance changes only when block.number is divisible by 15.
After a fallback call with exactly 10 ether, the caller's balance increase is either 0 if block.number is not divisible by 15, or the entire contract balance otherwise, in the reference version.

After any fallback call with exactly 10 ether, the contract's balance is either unchanged (0 change) or decreases by the full balance when block.number % 15 == 0, but never changes by any other amount.
After calling fallback() with 10 ether, the contract's balance never exceeds 0.
After any sequence of calls ending with a fallback that sends exactly 10 ether, the contract's balance must never be a multiple of 10 ether (i.e., not divisible by 10 ether).
After any fallback call with exactly 10 ether, the contract's balance is either unchanged or reduced by exactly 10 ether, but not increased.

After any sequence of calls ending with a fallback that solves the modulo-15 guard, the caller's ether balance is either unchanged or increased by exactly the contract's balance at the time of the transfer, never decreased.
After any fallback call with exactly 10 ether, the contract's balance modulo 15 ether is zero if and only if the caller's balance increases by the contract's balance at the time of the call.
